name: STARZ
notes: Researched from public support.starz.com articles and the public starz.com home page only (no sign-in). STARZ is charged automatically to a card, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay or Klarna; no bank account, no AutoPay enrollment, no paper bill, no guest payment and no payment plans. The billing date ('Access Until' in Settings) cannot be changed. The public offer data on starz.com states the regular month-to-month price as $11.99 (offer terms: promotions roll to month-to-month at the then-current price, currently $11.99) and a 12-month plan at $69.99 after promo; promotional variants ($4.99, $8.99, $9.99, $10.99/mo, $29.99/12 months) also appear; modeled plans are Monthly $11.99 and 12 months $69.99 (current, so a switch to the cheaper Monthly plan exists). Whether STARZ lets members switch billing period online is not documented (change_plan support inferred). Many members are billed by partners (Amazon, Apple, Google, Roku, cable); they change payment and cancel with that partner. Sign-in identifier (email) inferred. Reviewer 2026-10-10: Monthly price corrected from $10.99 to the regular $11.99 stated in the starz.com offer terms. Integrated 2026-10-10 (agent-solvability pass): annual plans carry billing.plans[].interval 'year' so prices show per year.

guest_pay.note: STARZ charges the payment method on your account; there is no bill to pay without logging in.

autopay.note: Your subscription is charged automatically on your billing date to the payment method on file.

autopay_cancel.note: To stop future charges, cancel your subscription.

scheduled_payment.note: Your billing date is set when you subscribe and cannot be changed.

payment_arrangement.note: STARZ is charged each billing period and installment plans are not offered.

cancel_service.note: You keep access until the end of your billing cycle. If you are billed by a partner such as Amazon, Apple, Google, Roku or your cable provider, cancel with that partner.

help.title: STARZ plans
paragraphs: STARZ Monthly is $11.99 a month and can be canceled any time. The 12-month plan is $69.99, charged once every 12 months. STARZ often runs promotional prices for new subscribers; when a promotion ends, the subscription continues month to month at the regular price.

help.title: Ways to pay for STARZ
paragraphs: STARZ accepts Visa, Mastercard, Discover, American Express, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay and Klarna.

To change your card or switch to PayPal, log in, select the profile icon, choose Settings, then Edit under My Subscription; enter the new details and choose Update. If you subscribe through a partner such as Google, Amazon or a cable or satellite provider, update your payment with that partner.
steps: Pick a card or PayPal and enter the details.

help.title: When you are billed
paragraphs: Your next billing date appears in Settings as Access Until. STARZ cannot change your billing date.

help.title: Cancel your STARZ subscription
paragraphs: On a computer, log in, select the user icon and choose Settings. Under Billing Plan & Information, select Cancel Subscription, follow the steps and select Submit. In the app, go to More, Settings, Account Management, then Cancel Subscription under My Subscription.
You keep watching until the end of the billing cycle and receive an email confirming the cancellation.
steps: Under Billing Plan & Information, select Cancel Subscription.
Follow the steps and select Submit.

extra.intent: Using the STARZ website, find the regular price of STARZ Monthly. Do not change your plan or make a payment.
Using the STARZ help pages, find the label STARZ uses in Settings to show your next billing date. Do not change anything.

solution.text: The next billing date is shown as Access Until.
